payload.reason: The evidence provides specific approaches used in text analysis, including statistical analysis, computational methods, and the integration of insights from humanities and social sciences.

claims.text: Statistical text analysis focuses on style, such as the distribution of function words, rather than content.
Computational analysis and close reading can complement each other in understanding texts.
Machine learning algorithms are used to semi-automatically extract features like hate speech from text.
The research process in text analysis involves identifying research questions, data selection, conceptualization, operationalization, and analysis.
